description: Start AI video generation from a prompt. Use listModels with kind=video to check models, supported lengths, and video credit costs. Confirm the model and cost with the user first. The finished video is saved as a draft and is not published. Check progress with getVideoStatus.

duration.description: Seconds. Default 8. Must be a length the model supports (see `durations` in listModels). Built-in Veo models: 4, 6, or 8; Sora: 4, 8, or 12.

model.description: A model id from GET /v1/models?kind=video (cost shown there), or a built-in name: veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview (default, 1 credit), veo-3.1-generate-preview (3), sora-2 (1), sora-2-pro (3).

prompt.description: Description of the video content to generate

name: generateVideo
